mechanism.claim: USD/MXN is a liquid high-beta global risk barometer. A completed New York cash-session dollar rise against the peso signals risk-off pressure and maps short BTC, while a dollar fall signals risk-on relief and maps long BTC, but only when BTC is already in a high realized-variation regime.
mechanism.side: negative sign of completed USDMXN 10:00-16:00 America/New_York log return

external_support.economic_channel: the Mexican peso is a liquid emerging-market risk currency and USD/MXN rises under global risk aversion
external_support.untested_adaptation: the completed US cash-session FX move is tested as a twelve-hour BTC relay

mechanism.why_distinct: No prior repository alpha uses USDMXN. MXRBR uses an external liquid EM currency session move, not crypto flow, funding, options, sentiment, or a terminal control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC prior-24h realized variation must rank at least 0.65 causally
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: weekday 16:05 ET entries conditioned on an external FX session are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.fx_session: exact USDMXN Polygon 1m bars [10:00,16:00) America/New_York on each Monday-Friday; all 360 timestamps required
features.fx_return: log(close of 15:59 minute/open of 10:00 minute); zero is ineligible
features.availability: 16:00 America/New_York after all 360 source bars complete
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared log(close/open)) over exact BTCUSDT 1m bars in the prior 24 elapsed hours ending at decision
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 252 previous valid weekday decision variations; minimum 126; current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.missing_duplicate_or_nonpositive: ineligible or source failure; no imputation

clock.decision: each Monday-Friday 16:00 America/New_York with complete FX and BTC source paths
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent liquid EM risk-currency channel plus user-required high volatility

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no session, threshold, side, hold, timing, volatility, or subset repair
